summary: Sandisk Corp filed an 8-K on May 14, 2026, disclosing an unsolicited mini-tender offer by Tutanota LLC for up to 100,000 shares (less than 0.07% of shares outstanding) at $1,150.00 per share. The offer price is conditioned on the closing price exceeding $1,150.00, meaning tendering stockholders may receive below-market value. Sandisk recommends rejecting the offer and notes shares can be withdrawn before the May 20, 2026 expiration. Tutanota may extend the offer for 45–180 day periods. This is a coercive mini-tender, not a full take-private bid. Watch for stockholder response and potential SEC scrutiny on mini-tender practices.
